## 安装依赖

需要支持 MiniMax H3 和子图的 ComfyUI，以及下列节点包：

- [ComfyUI-Capricorncd-Timeline](https://github.com/capricorncd/ComfyUI-Capricorncd-Timeline): Timeline Editor, Data Json Clip Parser, Cap MiniMaxH3, Seq To Video.
- [ComfyUI-Easy-Use](https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use): forLoopStart/End, ifElse, showAnything.
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes): INTConstant, LoraLoaderBypassModelOnly, MiniMax H3 Memory Efficient Sage Attention Patch.
- [MiniMax H3 Hybrid Loader](https://github.com/scottmudge/ComfyUI_MinimaxH3HybridLoader): MiniMaxH3HybridLoader.
- [MiniMax H3 Audio T8](https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8): MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.

还需可用的 FFmpeg。当前 Sage Attention Patch 属于实验性 CUDA 路径，需要与本机 PyTorch/CUDA 兼容的 SageAttention；安装节点包并不等于已经安装可用的注意力内核。遇到该节点错误，先检查依赖或明确旁路补丁，不要随机更换模型。此工作流不保证在所有显卡/后端运行，不承诺显存占用和速度。

## 模型文件

以下是工作流当前选中的文件名，目录相对于 ComfyUI 根目录：

| Directory / 目录 | Selected filename / 当前文件名 |
|---|---|
| `models/diffusion_models/` | `MiniMax_H3_FL2VA_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/diffusion_models/` | `MiniMax_H3_Ref2VA_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/text_encoders/` | `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/vae/` | `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` |
| `models/vae/` | `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` |
| `models/loras/MiniMaxH3/` | `fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.2_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors` |
| `models/loras/MiniMaxH3/` | `fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors` |

模型资源入口：[Comfy-Org MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main)、[MiniMax 官方项目](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3)。表中是本工作流的本地文件名，不是对下载文件名的保证；下载后在加载节点中选择对应格式的真实文件，不能只改后缀冒充另一种量化格式。4 步和 8 步 LoRA 分别用于相应分支。不要把节点 properties 中历史记录的 NVFP4 文件名误认为当前使用的 INT8 文本编码器。

当前模型连接：FL2VA 为 base、Ref2VA 为 overlay，`block_range_adaln`，blocks 25–49，final_adaln_from_overlay=false，weight_dtype=default。未连接的 UNETLoader 是备用节点，不是正在运行的模型路径。

## 时间轴使用

1. 加载工作流，在 Timeline Editor 打开时间轴。导入包含 `project.json` 与 `media/images|videos|audios` 的工程 ZIP，或添加自己的素材；单独的工作流 JSON 不会带入这些素材文件。
2. 在工程中设置宽、高、fps；当前示例为 864×480、24fps。尺寸通过连线进入采样子图，因此子图里灰色的旧宽高数值不是实际运行尺寸。
3. 在导演/主轨添加 Clip，调整起点与时长。为每段选择人物、场景、道具参考，确定参考顺序；图片编号始终对应当前 Clip 的启用图片顺序。
4. 在“提示词管理”编辑 Clip 提示词。多图 Ref2VA 将 subject_definitions、summary、retention_analysis、detailed_description 四段完整写入一个 Clip prompt。Subject 描述来源与特征，不能把四视图板布局当剧情。
5. 全局前置放风格和一致性；全局后置放 overall_soundscape、non_diegetic_music 与限制。最终固定顺序是：启用的前置 → 启用的素材描述 → Clip 提示词 → 启用的后置。已有完整 Subject 描述时可不启用素材描述，避免重复。
6. 设置非负 Clip 种子。此图已连接 Cap MiniMaxH3 的 seed 输出到 RandomNoise.noise_seed；后者旧随机数控件不再是种子来源。尚未设置的 -1 不应直接用于正式采样，先设置种子或预览以保存随机种子。
7. 可先运行当前 Clip；检查结果后再运行全部。保留循环起止节点，循环次数由时间轴输出连接控制，不要把旧控件数值当成固定片段数量。禁用的片段不应进入生成计划。
8. 输出片段由 Seq To Video 保存，output_video 来自当前 Clip 解析结果。使用时间轴的生成视频管理检查各段，再在“导出 → 合成视频”完成整片；单个片段 MP4 不等于整条时间轴已经合成。

## 4 步 / 8 步与预览

Single sampling 的布尔开关同时控制 LoRA 与采样步数：false = 4 步 LoRA + 4 steps；true = 8 步 LoRA + 8 steps。当前保存值 false。双时钟采样参数为 video shift=12、audio shift=3、dual_clock_euler、native_flow。不要只改 steps 而忘记切换配套 LoRA。

提示词管理里的“视频预览”使用单独导入的预览工作流；本文件不是 CAP_TimelinePreview 专用工作流。先配置包含“生成时间轴预览”节点的工作流、种子与预览 MP。预览可能等比缩小，即使种子一致，尺寸、模型/LoRA、采样参数不同也不能期待与正式视频完全一致。进度 100% 可能仅表示采样完成，解码与编码仍需时间。H3 帧数有对齐要求，必要时在最终合成时核对裁剪与音画时长。

# ComfyUI-Capricorncd-Timeline · MiniMax H3 Single-Sampling Timeline

Workflow: `CapTimeline_MiniMaxH3_v1_SingleSampling.json`. This guide describes its saved nodes and connections, with Capricorncd Tools 0.15.0 / project Schema 4. Workflow JSON does not bundle weights or media.

## What it does

Timeline → per-Clip loop → Clip parser → Single sampling subgraph → video/audio decode → per-Clip MP4.

“Single sampling” means one diffusion pass per Clip, not one shot for the entire timeline. No second-pass refinement or upscaling is connected. The graph uses a Hybrid model with Turbo LoRA, BasicGuider, RandomNoise and SamplerCustomAdvanced. Decoded audio is normalized to -14 LUFS.

## Requirements

Use ComfyUI with MiniMax H3 and subgraph support, plus:

- [ComfyUI-Capricorncd-Timeline](https://github.com/capricorncd/ComfyUI-Capricorncd-Timeline): Timeline Editor, Data Json Clip Parser, Cap MiniMaxH3, Seq To Video.
- [ComfyUI-Easy-Use](https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use): forLoopStart/End, ifElse, showAnything.
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes): INTConstant, LoraLoaderBypassModelOnly, MiniMax H3 Memory Efficient Sage Attention Patch.
- [MiniMax H3 Hybrid Loader](https://github.com/scottmudge/ComfyUI_MinimaxH3HybridLoader): MiniMaxH3HybridLoader.
- [MiniMax H3 Audio T8](https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8): MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.

FFmpeg must be available. The experimental Sage Attention Patch requires a working SageAttention installation compatible with your PyTorch/CUDA environment; installing a node pack alone is insufficient. Diagnose its dependencies or explicitly bypass that patch if unsupported. This workflow does not promise compatibility with every GPU/backend or a particular speed/VRAM footprint.

## Selected model files

Paths are relative to the ComfyUI root:

| Directory / 目录 | Selected filename / 当前文件名 |
|---|---|
| `models/diffusion_models/` | `MiniMax_H3_FL2VA_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/diffusion_models/` | `MiniMax_H3_Ref2VA_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/text_encoders/` | `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors` |
| `models/vae/` | `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` |
| `models/vae/` | `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` |
| `models/loras/MiniMaxH3/` | `fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.2_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors` |
| `models/loras/MiniMaxH3/` | `fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors` |

Model resources: [Comfy-Org MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main) and the [official MiniMax project](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3). These are local selections saved in this workflow, not guaranteed download filenames. Select the actual compatible files in each loader; renaming a file does not convert its quantization. Use each Turbo LoRA with its corresponding step branch. Historical NVFP4 entries in node properties do not override the currently selected INT8 text encoder.

Connected Hybrid settings: FL2VA base, Ref2VA overlay, block_range_adaln, blocks 25–49, final_adaln_from_overlay=false, weight_dtype=default. The disconnected UNETLoader is a spare, not part of the active model path.

## Using the timeline

1. Load the workflow and open Timeline Editor. Import a project ZIP containing project.json and media/images, media/videos or media/audios, or add your own assets. A workflow JSON alone does not distribute the referenced files.
2. Set project width, height and fps. The saved example uses 864×480 at 24fps. Connected project dimensions override stale disabled widget values inside the subgraph.
3. Arrange Clips on the director/main track and set timing. Assign character, scene and prop references in a deliberate order; Picture numbering follows enabled images in each Clip.
4. Edit the Clip prompt in Prompt Manager. For multi-reference Ref2VA, keep subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis and detailed_description together in that single field. Describe each Subject and its source; do not turn reference-sheet layouts into narrative shots.
5. Put style/continuity in the global prepend prompt; soundscape, music and restrictions in append. Assembly order is enabled prepend → enabled resource descriptions → Clip prompt → enabled append. Disable resource descriptions when they merely duplicate complete Subject definitions.
6. Set a nonnegative Clip seed. Cap MiniMaxH3.seed is already wired to RandomNoise.noise_seed; the old random-number widget is not the effective seed source. Resolve an unset -1 by setting a seed or running a preview that saves one.
7. Test the current Clip, then run all Clips. Keep the loop start/end nodes: the connected timeline count drives iteration, not the stale loop widget value. Disabled Clips should not be part of the generation plan.
8. Seq To Video saves each Clip using output_video from the parser. Review/attach results in the timeline, then use Export → Compose Video for the complete sequence. Saving one Clip MP4 is not the same as composing the full timeline.

## Steps and preview

The Single sampling boolean switches both LoRA and steps: false = 4-step LoRA / 4 steps; true = 8-step LoRA / 8 steps. The saved value is false. Dual-clock settings are video shift 12, audio shift 3, dual_clock_euler and native_flow. Do not change only the step count while leaving the wrong LoRA selected.

Prompt Manager's Video Preview tab uses a separately imported preview workflow. This file is not a dedicated CAP_TimelinePreview workflow. Configure a workflow containing Generate Timeline Preview, its seed and preview MP first. Downscaled previews can differ from final renders even with the same seed; match dimensions, model/LoRA and sampling parameters for comparisons. A 100% sampling indicator does not mean AV decoding/encoding has finished. H3 frame alignment may require checking trim and duration at final composition.
